newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. taxi driver injures 11 in Greenwich Village.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. taxi driver injures 11 in Greenwich Village.

text.p: Police were searching Saturday for a New York City taxi driver who fled after crashing his yellow cab into a crowded Greenwich Village storefront, injuring 11 people, three critically.
The driver lost control of his cab after cutting off another vehicle at the corner of Seventh Avenue and Bleecker Street, police said.
"The driver jumped the curb, hitting 11 pedestrians before crashing into a leather clothing store," a police spokesman said. He said the driver fled the scene.

Three of the pedestrians including the owner of the World of Leather Clothing shop were in critical but stable condition at Cabrini Hospital. Eight other people were also in area hospitals suffering minor injuries, police said. The injured range in age from 19 to 55 and include five women and six men.
The accident Friday night took place in a popular tourist area of Greenwich Village not far from the spectacular fireworks display that had ended about an hour earlier.
